mass for all bereaved parents: new altar list of the dead: bethany bereavement support: parish pastoral planning: the emmaus pastoral area: on sunday 1st november we have a special mass at 12 noon for parents who have lost a child during pregnancy, through miscarriage, still birth, in early childhood or who have a children interred in unblessed places. all parents, families and friends are cordially invited to attend. if you wish to participate in this mass, please contact the parish office. all our masses during november, the month of the holy souls and on each first friday and first saturday of the month throughout the year are offered for those whose names are inscribed on the new altar list of the dead. you are asked to complete your new altar list of the dead available from your planned giving boxes or from our churches and return them to the parish office by 1st november. the bethany bereavement support team begin their five-week healing programme in the parish centre, kingscourt, commencing on monday 2nd november at 8 for all who have been bereaved at any time. for further information contact the parish office or

. the parish pastoral team held their recent monthly meeting. among the items discussed and planned were 1. harvest mass. 2. preparations for the masses of remembrance and for deceased children in november. 3. there was feedback from the recent meeting of the parishes from the pastoral area. 4. the parish baptism policy was again reaffirmed, with the members of the baptismal team thanked and acknowledged for their great work. it was noted that all baptism arrangements can only be made with the baptismal team at the monthly meeting in the parish centre, held on the first thursday of every month, and not through the parish office. 5. the recent blessing of pets to mark the end of the season of creation was noteworthy. 6. a mass of remembrance for the members of the local deceased sporting clubs was agreed for november 21st at 6 p.m.and the deceased religious and priests will have a special mass on november 22nd at 12 noon. 7. preparations were begun for the annual service in january to mark the week of prayer for christian unity. the parishes of the emmaus pastoral area held their autumn meeting last week. they shared ideas and suggestions on sacramental preparation in their parishes. there was a short discussion on youth development with offering the samuel group to young people and the upcoming youth day in mullingar on novemb er 22nd. they had presentations from the bethany team and a timely one on addiction from fasn. they have also agreed on an evening of retreat and recollection in the spring for our pastoral area.
*congratulations to brendan mcmahon, carragh, on his roundy birthday! *meath diocesan youth day in mullingar on november 22nd. registration on eventbrite or email

. *drumconrath/meath hill harvest festival takes place this weekend. *congratulations to the 13 on their win in the shield final! coffee morning in the red hall on friday next at 11 a.m. and all are welcome. *healing mass in shercock on november 5th at 7 p.m. *a sincere word of gratitude to barry & the stars for the sporting county final - we now look forward to 2027! *congratulations to dylan byrne on his recent ulster all star award! *a meeting will take place of south monaghan pioneers on monday 2nd november 2026 at 8pm, in teach bhriain, in grounds of st. joseph’s church, carrickmacross. all pioneers and friends are welcome. *annual clothes collection in aid of fr. fernando’s parish takes place next wednesday oct. 28th. bags may be dropped at muff church monday 26th – wednesday 28th, 8am – 6pm. your support is much appreciated.
